queries.name: value-measurement-facts
queries.subject: Original native primary and diagnostic observations from reviewed batch evaluators.
queries.objective: Keep periods, native units, evaluator identity and missingness inspectable without inventing delivery events.
queries.acceptance: Null is unavailable, not zero. Interval measurements are not snapshots or cumulative accepted contributions.

queries.name: value-measurement-order
queries.subject: Latest assessment of each workflow measure, including unavailable assessments.
queries.objective: Do not let an older numeric value hide a newer incomplete period.
queries.acceptance: Choose latest cutoff and assessment before considering value or coverage; preserve evaluator digest.

queries.name: value-current-measurements
queries.subject: Latest native primary measurements, separately from event-ledger reports.
queries.objective: Expose ordinary reviewed batch results on the same Value surface.
queries.acceptance: Do not infer healthy outcomes, accepted implementations or complete coverage from a non-null value.

queries.name: value-evidence-facts
queries.subject: Published original evidence for frozen workflow value contracts.
queries.objective: Keep report identity, target repository, workflow and capture together.
queries.acceptance: Read canonical evidence only. No GitHub acquisition, HTML loading or fabricated evidence on navigation.

queries.name: value-contracts
queries.subject: One retained contract per repository, workflow and versioned native measure.
queries.objective: Compute each report independently before selecting current workflow results.
queries.acceptance: Preserve separate versions and exact report identity. Latest-version selection belongs to the workflow result query.

queries.name: value-measurement-captures
queries.subject: Accepted complete native batch assessments, separately from collection decisions.
queries.objective: Expose actual retained capture clocks without advancing them on failure or partial data.
queries.acceptance: Only mature complete non-null primary assessments establish an accepted capture; zero remains valid.

queries.name: value-contract-captures
queries.subject: Original capture clocks from accepted rich evidence packets.
queries.objective: Align capture metadata without merging measured populations.
queries.acceptance: This union is capture metadata only, never combined metric totals.

queries.name: value-capture-order
queries.subject: Actual captures across the retained measures of each workflow.
queries.objective: Expose the last accepted capture independently of collection decisions.
queries.acceptance: Select by original capture time. A deferred or failed check cannot advance evidence clocks.

queries.name: value-latest-capture
queries.subject: One last accepted capture per workflow, not a freshness claim.
queries.objective: Join capture and cutoff without multiplying collection registrations.
queries.acceptance: Missing packets remain unavailable, never zero or an inferred successful collection.

queries.name: value-collection-health
queries.subject: Reviewed registration and authoritative collection decisions, with independently retained evidence.
queries.objective: Explain disabled, unconfigured, deferred, failed and not-yet-captured workflows.
queries.acceptance: Use published collector facts, not missing result cards. Preserve decision, attempt, capture and cutoff as distinct clocks.

queries.name: value-snapshots
queries.subject: Independent repository-state observations and exact item drill-downs.
queries.objective: Keep everyone's changes separate from workflow-linked delivery.
queries.acceptance: Retain observed native values, dates and immutable references. Do not invent intermediate observations.

queries.name: value-first-snapshot-order
queries.subject: First independently observed repository state.
queries.objective: Name the actual first-snapshot reference rather than an invented baseline.
queries.acceptance: Strictly use retained snapshot time. A post-adoption snapshot is not a pre-adoption baseline.

queries.name: value-first-snapshot
queries.subject: First retained snapshot per report.
queries.objective: Provide the explicit reference value and date.
queries.acceptance: No retained reference means no comparison.

queries.name: value-last-snapshot-order
queries.subject: Latest independently observed repository state.
queries.objective: Show the actual last measurement rather than an extrapolation.
queries.acceptance: Preserve the latest retained snapshot even if unchanged.

queries.name: value-last-snapshot
queries.subject: Last retained snapshot per report.
queries.objective: Provide the current native observation.
queries.acceptance: One snapshot establishes state, not movement.

queries.name: value-output-counts
queries.subject: Retained safe outputs and applied creation receipts.
queries.objective: Describe output activity without treating it as accepted value.
queries.acceptance: Count distinct validated output facts. Tracking corroboration is not an applied receipt.

queries.name: value-implementation-counts
queries.subject: Distinct accepted implementations and their measured native effects.
queries.objective: Count each accepted implementation once, including zero and negative effects.
queries.acceptance: Validated implementation identities are unique; many-to-many output edges must not multiply value. Complete coverage is checked separately.

queries.name: value-covered-durations
queries.subject: Explicit complete evidence durations in the report and adjacent 28-day delivery periods.
queries.objective: Distinguish known zero from gaps or incomplete evidence.
queries.acceptance: The producer validates non-overlapping bounded coverage. Count only complete intervals, clipped to each exact half-open period.

queries.name: value-report-delivery
queries.subject: Evidence-qualified output and accepted-contribution totals.
queries.objective: Keep populations and native units separate without an implied conversion rate.
queries.acceptance: Absent output context is unknown. Missing coverage withholds complete totals and recent zero, retaining labelled known subtotals.

queries.name: value-report-summary
queries.subject: Shared native card and report comparison against the first retained snapshot.
queries.objective: Show signed repository-wide movement, the goal direction and the exact comparison dates.
queries.acceptance: This first/last snapshot comparison is not the adjacent-period alert policy, a pre-adoption baseline or causal workflow credit. One snapshot is not zero change.

queries.name: value-workflow-result-order
queries.subject: Version ordering after independently computing each report.
queries.objective: Keep exact report queries partition-local without changing latest-version selection.
queries.acceptance: Rank cutoffs then captures within each workflow and measure. Explicit report links do not need other report facts.

queries.name: value-workflow-results
queries.subject: Current published report results per native measure.
queries.objective: Expose the latest coherent packet on the workflow Value tab.
queries.acceptance: Never replace missing facts with an older measured version. Explicit report links retain their own version.

queries.name: value-workflow-headline-order
queries.subject: Most recent current report across the measures of each workflow.
queries.objective: Give each workflow and repository one headline result; other measures stay on the workflow page.
queries.acceptance: Select by cutoff then capture. Never replace a missing result with an older or zero value.

queries.name: value-workflow-headlines
queries.subject: One headline result per workflow and repository.
queries.objective: Join cleanly to collection health without multiplying rows.
queries.acceptance: Exactly one row per workflow route.

queries.name: value-native-headline-order
queries.subject: Most recent primary native measurement for each repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Let ordinary batch Value functions participate in the universal Value inventory without requiring a rich report packet.
queries.acceptance: Select by evidence cutoff then assessment time. A newer unavailable assessment remains current and must not reveal an older numeric value.

queries.name: value-native-headlines
queries.subject: One current primary native measurement per repository and workflow.
queries.objective: Supply a bounded workflow headline when no richer evidence report exists.
queries.acceptance: Keep missing value, coverage, maturity, native unit and campaign context unchanged.

queries.name: value-rich-headline-overview
queries.subject: Rich evidence report headlines normalized for universal Value subject selection.
queries.objective: Reuse the existing repository movement result without changing its evidence identity or comparison.
queries.acceptance: Retain the report route and first-to-last native movement; campaign context remains unknown unless another canonical source supplies it.

queries.name: value-native-headline-overview
queries.subject: Native batch measurements normalized for universal Value subject selection.
queries.objective: Expose the current native result while keeping comparison unavailable unless a reviewed comparison exists.
queries.acceptance: A numeric measurement is not a trend or causal result. Missing remains unavailable and routes to workflow detail.

queries.name: value-headline-candidates
queries.subject: Rich and native headline candidates for one exact repository and workflow deployment.
queries.objective: Choose one current drill target without combining unlike measurements.
queries.acceptance: Order by evidence cutoff and capture before preferring richer presentation. Never aggregate headline values.

queries.name: value-headline-order
queries.subject: Current headline ordering for each exact repository and workflow deployment.
queries.objective: Prefer the newest evidence, then a rich evidence route when timestamps are equal.
queries.acceptance: A newer unavailable native assessment remains current. Rich presentation priority cannot cross an evidence-time gap.

queries.name: value-headlines
queries.subject: One current Value headline per exact repository and workflow deployment.
queries.objective: Join current evidence to collection health and workflow topology without multiplying subjects.
queries.acceptance: Exactly one row per workflow route, with no cross-metric aggregation.

queries.name: value-workflow-topology
queries.subject: Canonical workflow deployment topology for Value grouping.
queries.objective: Classify exact workflow identities as campaign workers, orchestrators or standalone workflows without copying topology into evidence.
queries.acceptance: Campaign and role come only from canonical workflow inventory. Missing topology remains unknown.

queries.name: value-health-subjects
queries.subject: Value subjects observed through authoritative collection decisions.
queries.objective: Keep enabled, disabled and unconfigured deployments visible even before evidence exists.
queries.acceptance: A collection decision supplies subject identity, not campaign topology or outcome attainment.

queries.name: value-headline-subjects
queries.subject: Value subjects observed through retained native or rich evidence.
queries.objective: Keep published outcomes visible when collection-health publication is absent.
queries.acceptance: Evidence supplies subject identity but cannot infer registration.

queries.name: value-topology-subjects
queries.subject: Declared workflow subjects without required collection or evidence observations.
queries.objective: Make every canonical campaign and standalone workflow visible with unknown Value configuration when health is missing.
queries.acceptance: Inventory presence does not imply registration, evidence, successful collection or measurable Value.

queries.name: value-subject-candidates
queries.subject: All exact workflow deployment identities observed by inventory, collection health or accepted evidence.
queries.objective: Build one universal subject population without losing evidence-only or inventory-only deployments.
queries.acceptance: Identity union is not evidence aggregation. Each route is selected once in the next query.

queries.name: value-subject-order
queries.subject: Deterministic subject identity selection across inventory, health and evidence sources.
queries.objective: Prefer authoritative collection identity, then evidence identity, then declaration-only identity.
queries.acceptance: Exactly one selected identity per workflow route without changing topology or outcome facts.

queries.name: value-subjects
queries.subject: One universal Value subject per exact repository and workflow deployment.
queries.objective: Provide the stable subject grain for all, campaign, standalone and review projections.
queries.acceptance: One row per workflow route. Missing health, topology or evidence remains missing after joins.

queries.name: value-workflow-overview
queries.subject: One universal row per repository and workflow deployment with topology, collection health and current Value evidence.
queries.objective: Compare campaign and standalone Value subjects through one honest card contract.
queries.acceptance: Missing topology is unclassified, missing health is unknown and missing evidence is unavailable. None becomes zero or inferred success.

queries.name: value-campaign-deployments
queries.subject: Universal Value deployments grouped under a declared campaign.
queries.objective: Support campaign coverage and workflow drilldown without creating a separate evidence system.
queries.acceptance: Only rows with canonical campaign context are included. Unclassified deployments remain visible in All and Needs review.

queries.name: value-campaign-totals
queries.subject: Campaign Value coverage and attention summary over exact workflow deployments.
queries.objective: Aggregate campaign coverage and attention counts before presentation fields are derived.
queries.acceptance: Counts describe deployment coverage and attention only. They do not average native outcomes or create a campaign score.

queries.name: value-campaign-overview
queries.subject: Campaign Value coverage and attention presentation.
queries.objective: Find campaigns requiring evidence or outcome review before drilling into their workers.
queries.acceptance: Presentation fields derive only from bounded campaign deployment counts. No native outcome values are combined.

queries.name: value-standalone-overview
queries.subject: Standalone workflow Value deployments.
queries.objective: Inspect standalone workflows through the same collection, outcome and evidence contract as campaign workers.
queries.acceptance: Standalone is a canonical workflow role, not inferred from missing campaign evidence.

queries.name: value-review-overview
queries.subject: Value deployments with measured deterioration or incomplete collection/evidence state.
queries.objective: Prioritize exact deployments needing outcome or evidence investigation.
queries.acceptance: Each row preserves its explicit reason. Missing evidence, failed collection and worsening outcome are not interchangeable.

queries.name: value-intent-sources
queries.subject: Immutable extracted workflow intent sources.
queries.objective: Let readers inspect the original goal and requirements.
queries.acceptance: Only retained HTTPS evidence is linked; workflow text remains untrusted.

queries.name: value-requirements
queries.subject: Original full acceptance requirements.
queries.objective: Distinguish the measured structural facet from all workflow safeguards.
queries.acceptance: Requirements are source text, not proof they passed.

queries.name: value-outputs
queries.subject: Retained safe-output lifecycle facts.
queries.objective: Show receipts, current-at-cutoff state and originating evidence.
queries.acceptance: A closed output is not automatically an accepted implementation; absence of a link is unknown.

queries.name: value-output-origin-evidence
queries.subject: Retained producer and applied safe-output evidence.
queries.objective: Let readers distinguish receipt-confirmed creation from corroborated tracking.
queries.acceptance: Tracking identities locate outputs but do not establish accepted value. Keep unavailable producer evidence explicit.

queries.name: value-implementations
queries.subject: Accepted implementations and native before/after effects.
queries.objective: Expose delivery time and immutable acceptance evidence.
queries.acceptance: Do not equate acceptance with full quality verification or omit negative effects.

queries.name: value-output-trails
queries.subject: Explicit output-to-implementation edges.
queries.objective: Make the trail from a proposal to an accepted measured change inspectable.
queries.acceptance: Use retained dated edges only. Many-to-many links do not duplicate headline counts or values.

queries.name: value-implementation-files
queries.subject: Measured implementation files and retained lineage sources.
queries.objective: Link to exact Git facts rather than only a repository tree.
queries.acceptance: No URL is reconstructed from an unrelated revision. Preserve before, after and replacement file evidence.

queries.name: value-quality-checks
queries.subject: Explicit independent verification checks.
queries.objective: Keep unverified behavior, tests and other safeguards visible.
queries.acceptance: Missing or not-verified is not a passing check.

queries.name: value-limitations
queries.subject: Retained evidence and attribution limitations.
queries.objective: Qualify claims without inventing completeness.
queries.acceptance: Treat source limitations as untrusted text and never suppress them.

queries.name: value-snapshot-items
queries.subject: Actual counted items at an independent immutable snapshot.
queries.objective: Open exact per-item evidence from the plotted observation.
queries.acceptance: Only retained items are shown. Missing item evidence must not look like an empty measured population.

pages.title: Native measurement
pages.description: Inspect an original batch assessment and its exact evidence period without inferring accepted changes or verified quality.
pages.intent: Inspect a native outcome measurement under its frozen evaluator.
pages.subject: One original canonical operational-value observation.
pages.objective: Keep missingness, coverage, maturity and immutable fingerprints visible.
pages.acceptance: Never replace null with zero or reinterpret interval results as repository snapshots.

pages.title: Workflow value
pages.description: Inspect measured repository movement and open the evidence behind a workflow's result.
pages.intent: Judge the selected workflow's repository outcome and open its evidence report.
pages.subject: Frozen workflow value measurements and their published evidence.
pages.objective: See native outcome movement at a glance without confusing it with workflow activity.
pages.acceptance: Cards and reports use the same evidence packet. Show comparison dates, direction and unavailable evidence; never imply causal credit or acquire evidence on navigation.

views.title: Collection health
views.subject: The selected workflow's published registration and collection decision.
views.objective: Separate acquisition health from retained repository outcomes.
views.acceptance: Show actual reasons and separate clocks. Absent collection facts are unknown, not proof of absent registration.
views.empty-message: Collection status has not been published for this workflow. Missing status does not prove that collection is unconfigured.

views.title: Repository outcomes
views.subject: Direction-aware native changes for this workflow's measured repository problems.
views.objective: Open the evidence behind one compact result card.
views.acceptance: A card is a first-to-last snapshot comparison, not an alert, causal rating or conversion rate. Missing evidence is not zero.
views.empty-message: No accepted Value evidence is retained for this workflow. See collection health above; missing evidence is not zero value.

views.title: Native measurements
views.empty-message: No native batch measurements are retained for this workflow.

pages.title: Workflow value report
pages.description: Trace workflow intent through safe outputs, accepted changes and independent repository measurements.
pages.intent: Explain one workflow value result through its intent, safe outputs, acceptance and native evidence.
pages.subject: One coherent published evidence packet and independently measured repository history.
pages.objective: Inspect the result and follow the exact evidence behind it by category without scanning one unbounded page.
pages.acceptance: Read the same complete packet as its Value card; preserve zero, negative, incomplete and unverified evidence. Disclose one counted category at a time and progressively render searchable sortable tables without truncating their query sources. No causal score or interactive GitHub acquisition.

pages.title: Measured snapshot
pages.description: Verify the exact items counted at one retained repository snapshot.
pages.intent: Inspect the actual counted items behind an independent repository observation.
pages.subject: One immutable repository-state snapshot and its retained per-item links.
pages.objective: Verify what the plotted native value counts.
pages.acceptance: Keep missing item evidence distinct from a measured empty population. Do not substitute a repository tree for item-level evidence.

pages.title: Value
pages.description: Review every known campaign and standalone Value deployment through one evidence contract.
pages.intent: Find which workflow deployment needs attention and distinguish measured outcome movement from evidence availability.
pages.subject: Canonical workflow inventory, reviewed Value collection decisions and latest retained native or rich evidence.
pages.objective: Open the exact workflow result or collection state without separating campaign and standalone evidence systems.
pages.acceptance: Keep repository/workflow identity, topology, native result, collection state, dates and unknowns visible. No campaign score, causal credit or GitHub acquisition.

views.title: All Value deployments
views.description: Optional acquisition must leave capacity for Activity. A recent status check does not make retained measurements fresh.
views.subject: One card per exact repository and workflow deployment across campaign, standalone and unclassified topology.
views.objective: Open retained evidence directly while workflows without a result open collection detail.
views.acceptance: Never infer campaign membership, opt-in, successful capture or zero value from missing facts.
views.empty-message: No workflow inventory, Value collection decisions or retained Value evidence are available.

pages.title: Campaign Value
pages.description: Review campaign coverage and attention before opening exact worker deployments.
pages.intent: Find which campaign has missing evidence, collection failures or worker outcomes requiring investigation.
pages.subject: Campaign projections over exact repository/workflow Value deployments.
pages.objective: Prioritize campaign drilldown without averaging incompatible native outcomes.
pages.acceptance: Show deployment and repository coverage plus explicit review counts. Do not create a cross-metric campaign score.

views.title: Campaigns
views.description: Coverage and review state are aggregated; native outcomes remain on their exact worker deployments.
views.subject: One campaign card from its exact Value deployment inventory.
views.objective: Open the campaign's worker Value deployments that need evidence or outcome investigation.
views.acceptance: Counts retain explicit configured, current, unconfigured, deferred and failed populations. No score or averaged outcome.
views.empty-message: No Value deployment has retained canonical campaign context.

pages.title: Standalone Value
pages.description: Review standalone workflows through the same collection and evidence contract used for campaign workers.
pages.intent: Find which standalone workflow needs outcome or evidence investigation.
pages.subject: Exact Value deployments whose canonical workflow role is standalone.
pages.objective: Open current standalone results without inventing campaign membership.
pages.acceptance: Standalone classification comes only from canonical workflow inventory. Missing topology remains in All, not here.

views.title: Standalone workflows
views.subject: One card per exact standalone repository/workflow deployment.
views.objective: Open retained evidence or collection detail for standalone workflows.
views.acceptance: Use the universal workflow card and preserve unavailable evidence as unavailable.
views.empty-message: No workflow with canonical standalone topology is present in the Value inventory.

pages.title: Value needing review
pages.description: Review measured deterioration and evidence availability as separate conditions.
pages.intent: Select an exact deployment whose outcome or Value evidence requires review.
pages.subject: Value deployments with worsening measured outcomes, failed or deferred collection, unconfigured collection, or no retained result.
pages.objective: Prioritize review without converting missing evidence into a failed outcome.
pages.acceptance: Keep each row's explicit attention reason. No review triggered is not an all-clear and does not appear here.

views.title: Needs review
views.subject: Exact workflow deployments with a declared outcome or evidence attention condition.
views.objective: Open the retained result or collection detail supporting the review basis.
views.acceptance: Worsening, failed, deferred, unconfigured and missing-result states remain distinguishable.
views.empty-message: No Value deployment currently has a retained review condition. This is not an all-clear for unavailable inventory.

pages.title: Campaign Value
pages.description: Inspect one campaign's Value coverage and exact worker deployments.
pages.intent: Understand why the selected campaign needs review and open the responsible workflow evidence.
pages.subject: The selected campaign's deployment coverage and repository/workflow Value cards.
pages.objective: Move from campaign coverage to exact worker evidence without changing measurement semantics.
pages.acceptance: Reuse universal cards and original evidence routes. Do not synthesize a campaign score or attribute worker outcomes to orchestration.

views.title: Campaign coverage
views.subject: Coverage and review counts for the selected campaign.
views.objective: Explain whether attention comes from configuration, collection or missing results before opening workers.
views.acceptance: Counts are bounded to the selected campaign and do not aggregate native outcome values.
views.empty-message: The selected campaign has no retained Value deployment context.

views.title: Workflow deployments
views.description: Native outcomes remain separate by workflow and repository.
views.subject: Exact Value deployments belonging to the selected campaign.
views.objective: Open the workflow result or collection detail responsible for campaign coverage and attention.
views.acceptance: Preserve every worker's native metric, state and evidence route without averaging.
views.empty-message: No exact workflow deployment is classified under the selected campaign.
